relationships.subject: Nociceptors
relationships.evidence_quote: It also led to immune reactions in the skin in the absence of inflammation and potentiation of established inflammation, a consequence of the antidromic activation of nociceptor peripheral terminals.

key_findings: Wireless epineural optogenetic stimulation of TRPV1-lineage nociceptors in the sciatic nerve evokes pain behaviors.
Nociceptor activation causes skin immune reactions and potentiates established inflammation via antidromic activation.
